comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and AMD disclose advancements in integrated chip architectures and packaging technologies. Intel explicitly details its Foundry capabilities in packaging single or multiple chips together and driving the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) standard to optimize systems of chips. Similarly, AMD describes the launch of its Versal Series Gen 2 devices, which integrate preprocessing, AI inference, and postprocessing into a single adaptive SoC for end-to-end acceleration, reflecting a shared industry focus on advanced chip integration and systems-level optimization.

sentences.text: Intel Foundry's advanced semiconductor assembly and test offerings include families of advanced technologies for packaging single chips or combining multiple chips together in a package, adjacent to each other, stacked on top of each other, or through a combination thereof.

We continue to drive the technologies, capabilities, and standards needed to optimize systems of chips, including the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express* standard for communication between chips in a system, which we demonstrated in silicon in 2023.

We expanded our adaptive computing portfolio with differentiated solutions with the launch of the new Versal™ Series Gen 2 devices, including the new Versal AI Edge Series Gen 2 and Versal Prime Series Gen 2 adaptive SoCs, which bring preprocessing, AI inference, and postprocessing together in a single device for end-to-end acceleration of AI-driven embedded systems.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company began enabling cleanroom space for EUV lithography in Hiroshima, Japan, expanded an assembly and test facility in Xi'an, China, and is progressing construction of a facility in Gujarat, India to support future global customer demand.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose investments in back-end assembly and test infrastructure to support customer demand. Intel Foundry highlights its advanced semiconductor assembly and test offerings, including technologies for combining multiple chips in a package. Micron similarly discusses advancing its global back-end assembly and test network, specifically noting construction expansions for assembly and test facilities in Xi'an, China, and Gujarat, India to extend its ability to deliver on global customer demand.

sentences.text: Intel Foundry's advanced semiconductor assembly and test offerings include families of advanced technologies for packaging single chips or combining multiple chips together in a package, adjacent to each other, stacked on top of each other, or through a combination thereof.
In addition to our core packaging technologies, we have differentiated capabilities to design and produce complex packaged parts with optimal performance, power, and cost at high yield.
We also continue to advance our global back-end assembly and test network in order to support our product portfolio and extend our ability to deliver on global customer demand in the future.

We have started construction to expand our existing assembly and test facility in Xi'an, China, to provide space to add more product capability, to allow us over time to serve more of the demand from our customers in China.
Construction is also progressing for the assembly and test facility in Gujarat, India to address demand in the latter half of this decade.

comparisons.peer_summary: Automotive revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $1.1 billion, up 21% from fiscal year 2023. The company partnered with MediaTek for automotive SoCs, collaborated with Foxconn on next-generation EVs, and expanded the adoption of the NVIDIA DRIVE platform with several global OEMs.

Intel emphasizes its role in driving the Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express (UCIe) standard to optimize systems of chips. NVIDIA similarly reports on a partnership with MediaTek to develop automotive systems on chips that integrate a new NVIDIA GPU chiplet IP, demonstrating a parallel industry trend toward chiplet architectures and standardized interconnects for AI and automotive applications.
